end.summary:
Practised representing numbers 11–20 as one bundle of ten and loose ones.
For 14, identified one ten bundle and four loose sticks after discussion.
For 17, identified one ten and seven loose sticks.
Two unaided correct attempts were recorded; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Saanvi practised building teen numbers with one bundle of ten and loose ones. They worked through the mix-up between the digit 1 and a bundle of ten; for 14, this was corrected later in the lesson, and they stated “one ten and four loose sticks.” At home, use ten small objects tied together as one bundle, then add loose objects for numbers such as 12, 14, and 17.
